strings.name: Jean-Claude Juncker
strings.summary: A law graduate, Juncker became Luxembourg’s long-serving premier and Eurogroup president. He led the European Commission in 2014–2019 through investment initiatives, euro-area disputes and Brexit. His Luxembourg government fell in 2013 over intelligence-service abuses and oversight. After leaving EU office, he remained a public commentator, including a 2026 radio interview.
